findings.text: The restatement of `runScriptStep_insertWithRules_eq` gives the cases of the right side but not the assumption `found` (the statement resolves to an INSERT of literal rows with write rules and no RETURNING columns) or that the equation holds for every context, clock, index, connection and parameter list. Fix: start the docstring with one sentence that states the resolution premise and the quantified variables.

The status file assumes that it records the checks of the commit, but `AGENTS.md` ("Checks and their cadence") says the status file names the tests of each commit, and the file does not name `test_insert_with_rules_reports_its_count_or_error` or any other check. Fix: add one line that names the pytest test of this commit.
